comment: The lifecycle (plan §2.5, LSP 3.17): before initialize every request, known or not, is ServerNotInitialized (-32002) and a notification is dropped; initialize is answered at once with the capabilities that exist (utf-16 when the client offers no utf-8), never waiting on the daemon; a second initialize is InvalidRequest; shutdown answers null, after which a request is InvalidRequest; exit ends the session, the input after it unread, and the process exits 0 because shutdown came first. No request here needs the daemon, so none is started.
